description: This Java class defines a REST controller for generating various reports in a backend API, including customer bill reports, monthly summaries, and revenue summaries.

classes.name: ReportsController
classes.description: RestController managing report endpoints for customer billing, monthly summaries, and revenue reports.

methods.name: customer
methods.description: Handles GET requests to generate a customer bill report based on customerId.

methods.name: monthly
methods.description: Handles GET requests to generate a monthly report for a specified year and month.

methods.name: revenue
methods.description: Handles GET requests to generate a revenue summary report.
